status.en: 22 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Ituri.
status.nb: 22 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Ituri.

summary.en: M23 rebels have shifted from Bunia to open a new front near the Uganda border, advancing toward Uvira city, while Ugandan forces are pulling out of a Congolese town after a diplomatic dispute involving Muhoozi Kainerugaba's social media posts. In Ituri, fighting forced WHO to evacuate its Ebola response team from a hospital as the outbreak surpassed 12,000 cases. A South African mercenary pilot was captured, raising concerns about foreign fighters. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
